verdict.rationale: ClickHouse documents an official CLI, clickhousectl, installed via `curl https://clickhouse.com/cli | sh`. It manages local versions and servers, executes queries, and manages Cloud services and ClickPipes. It also has an explicitly AI-native feature: installing official ClickHouse agent skills into coding agents. clickhouse-local adds a further official command-line SQL tool, which a community user praises. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of clickhousectl specifically, and evidence of agent-oriented details such as machine-readable output or non-interactive auth.
